discrepancy_resolution: ten definite findings (D1-D10) are scored by eight checks: D2, D3 and D4 are one competency check (C_COMP); the other seven findings each have their own check. Every finding maps to exactly one check, and every check to at least one finding; the mapping is enforced by a test.

D1.statement: 16 duty lines of the Responsibilities section are extracted as from_responsibilities items

D2.statement: competency line 'Good understanding of business applications, digital platforms, and software support processes.' is covered by an item

D3.statement: competency line 'Ability to support system testing, troubleshooting, issue tracking, and operational follow-up activities.' is covered by an item

D4.statement: competency line 'Ability to communicate effectively with users, understand their requirements and issues, and support their resolution in coordination with relevant stakeholders.' is covered by an item

D5.statement: the experience item for '1–3 years … ICT systems support, business applications, digital platforms, or software implementation projects' has these alternatives

D6.statement: the familiarity line's 'or' list is in alternatives

D7.statement: 'Knowledge of the local business and regulatory environment' is in domain_knowledge

D8.statement: the work location statement is a location condition in non_scoreable_requirements

D9.statement: the reporting statement is a reporting_line condition in informational_items

D10.statement: 'Strong communication, coordination, and teamwork skills' gives separate items for communication, coordination and teamwork

report_only.invented_items: items whose source_text is not verbatim in the JD (rule 2), and from_responsibilities items whose source_text is not a JD duty line (rule 7)
report_only.warnings: the number of model warnings per call (no pass/fail: rule 4 asks for warnings only where grouping is unclear)
report_only.consistency: per check: number of the N calls that pass; item-count range; invalid JSON count

duty_lines: Support the implementation, rollout, operational stabilization, and continuous improvement of ABRS services and related digital platforms.
Coordinate with MoNE teams and the ABRS vendor to identify, track, and resolve system, operational, and integration issues.
Support the implementation, validation, and deployment of system enhancements, configuration changes, releases, and new service functionalities.
Participate in functional, integration, and user acceptance testing activities.
Support the monitoring and follow-up of system performance, service availability, and operational issues.
Support data validation, reconciliation, verification, and reporting activities related to ABRS services and integrations.
Assist in the implementation, testing, and operational support of system integrations and data exchange processes.
Support the analysis, documentation, and follow-up of enhancement requests, operational requirements, and system improvements.
Coordinate with business, legal, and technical teams to support the implementation of new services and enhancements.
Support the review, optimization, and digitization of business processes, procedures, forms, notifications, and user-facing content related to ABRS services.
Contribute to the identification and implementation of opportunities for service improvement, operational efficiency, and service quality enhancement.
Support knowledge-transfer activities related to ABRS administration, operation, support, and enhancement.
Provide on-the-job coaching and technical guidance to MoNE ICT staff.
Support the preparation of operational guides, procedures, and technical documentation.
Participate in workshops, demonstrations, training sessions, and coordination meetings related to ABRS services and operations.
Contribute to strengthening MoNE’s capacity to independently support, maintain, and enhance ABRS services and related digital platforms.
competency_lines: Good understanding of business applications, digital platforms, and software support processes.
Ability to support system testing, troubleshooting, issue tracking, and operational follow-up activities.
Ability to communicate effectively with users, understand their requirements and issues, and support their resolution in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
